reuse.why: Changes only the existing isWeekendOrHoliday predicate, which every holiday check in the tree already goes through.

duplication.why: No duplicated logic; the MM-DD match is added once.

placement.why: The matching lives in the shared holiday predicate in shared/schedules.ts, with the format documented on RecurConfig.

scope.why: Predicate, type doc comment, a focused test and a release note only.

maintainability.why: A minimal, commented change at the single point of truth.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All callers (getNextDate, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange) use isWeekendOrHoliday.
